lessons.title: Duration with desde and hace
lessons.objective: Duration with desde and hace: Desde names a starting point; desde hace names elapsed duration.
lessons.explanation:
Desde names a starting point; desde hace names elapsed duration. With an ongoing situation, Spanish often uses present where English uses have been.
Vivo aquí desde enero. — I have lived here since January.
Trabajo en la biblioteca desde hace dos meses. — I have worked at the library for two months.
